cells.U: This Road is not included in Asset register as well as in GO, But AS accorded for 17.1 Cr under Budget work 2018-19 for new road formation. Awaiting revalidated AS .The road continues to proposed Outpost Bridge by KIIFB .Total length 4.250Km from left of punjiri jetty and continues to GHS Kuppappuram from right of Punjiri jetty. cells.L: Ch 7/100 of Nedumudi Karuvatta road (Proposed Kanachery bridge approach end
cells.U: This Road is not included in Asset register as well as in GO, But AS accorded for 17.1 Cr under Budget work 2018-19 for new road formation. After tender procedure and agreement, the awarded contractor couldnt complete due to the breakage of paddy field bund for approx 2 years.Hence the work was terminated without risk and cost. Revalidated AS accorded , but after soil investigation procedures, KHRI suggests soil improvement works in addition to the new formation, hence the new estimate after 18%GST, DSoR change and soil improvements works comes to 43.857CR. Awaiting revalidated AS .The road continues to proposed Outpost Bridge by KIIFB .Total length 4.250Km from left of punjiri jetty and continues to GHS Kuppappuram from right of Punjiri jetty. This road can reduce duration of the journey to Alleppy from urban areas of Kuttanadu.Also Tourists can easily accessible to Kuttanadu from Alappuzha.Hence this stretch may be considered to include in GO. Multiple intermediate points were included for site verification.The given map is wrong alignment.
